tex.title: CityGML Texture Editor
tex.pane3d_empty: Select a building to see it in 3D (click a LOD2 face to select that face)
tex.faces_empty: On the 2D map, select a building that has LOD2 (detailed shape)
tex.new_assign_note: 🆕 This building has no textures yet. Pasting a photo assigns new textures (a new atlas image is created for this one building; walls without a photo stay blank)
tex.compare3d_hint: Rotate or zoom either 3D view and the other follows the same viewpoint.
tex.flat_compare_title: Flat image comparison: before and after
tex.flat_compare_hint: The Before tone affects the comparison display only; the After tone is also applied to the submitted data and the 3D preview.
tex.btn_camera: 📷 Paste from a single photo (camera alignment)
tex.camera_hint: One street-level photo updates every face visible in it (hidden areas keep their current texture)
tex.cam_editor_title: Camera alignment — paste from a photo
tex.cam_drop: 📷 Drag & drop a photo of the building here (or click to choose one)
tex.cam_base_warn: ⚠️ You picked a bottom point — in the photo, click directly below the roof corner (where it meets the ground), not the base of the wall (on buildings with overhanging roofs, the wall base does not match the model)
tex.cam_hint: 1. Click a marker in the 3D view (yellow = corner, orange = face center) → 2. click the same spot in the photo; repeat for at least 6 pairs. The selected marker turns large and orange (pick corners where they are clearly visible; face centers are easier for bands, eaves, etc.). Matched points get the same number in the photo and the 3D view.
tex.tone_reapply_note: (after changing, press "Create paste candidates" again to apply)
tex.editor_title_single: Replace the face photo (roof etc., single face)
tex.drop: 📷 Drag & drop a photo here (or click to choose one)
tex.warp_hint: Drag the four corners of the wall into place in the order top-left → top-right → bottom-right → bottom-left (tilt and keystone distortion are corrected automatically)
tex.btn_compare_title: Switches the editing 3D view on the left to the state before your changes
tex.reason_label: Reason / supporting details (e.g. shooting date; included in the PR body)
tex.reason_placeholder: e.g. Updated with facade photos taken on site in 2026-07 (appearance after renovation)
tex.cc0_text: The photos I used are my own work and I provide them as CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication; I will not assert moral rights). I confirm that no faces, license plates, etc. are visible, and I have read the
tex.confirm_discard_move: You have unsubmitted edits. Discard them and move on? (PRs are created per building)
tex.no_lod2_walls: This building has no LOD2 (detailed shape) wall faces
tex.image_load_error: Could not load the image (if it is an iPhone HEIC file, convert it to JPEG)
tex.shared_uneditable: Cannot edit: this face is shared by multiple buildings
tex.invalid_corners: Invalid corner positions (e.g. all on one line)
tex.pr_progress: Generating images → apply → branch → commit → push → PR …
tex.solve_failed: Alignment failed (check that the points are not all on one line or in one plane)
tex.no_visible_faces: No editable faces visible in the photo were found
tex.candidates_title: Paste candidates (visible share; check the preview in the 3D view)
tex.wall_editor_title_new: Assign new photos to wall {id} (auto-split across {n} faces; whole wall {w}×{h} m)
tex.wall_editor_title_replace: Replace the photos of wall {id} (auto-split across {n} faces; whole wall {w}×{h} m)
tex.pr_create_here: Create the pull request from here
tex.cam_click_pending: → In the photo, click the {kind} shown large and orange in the 3D view
tex.cam_pick_marker: Click a marker in the 3D view (yellow = corner, orange = face center; matched points keep the same number in the photo and the 3D view)
tex.cam_pairs_count: Matched points: {n} pairs (6 or more enable alignment)
tex.cam_solved: Aligned: reprojection error {err}px (fine if the cyan wireframe overlaps the building; add matched points if it is off)
tex.reproj_error_large: The reprojection error is rather large ({err}px). Add or re-check matched points
tex.applied_n_faces: Applied to {n} faces (before creating the PR you can add more from another photo)
tex.err_already_textured: This building already has textures (use replace mode)
tex.err_new_single_image: New texturing uses one image (one atlas) per building
tex.err_unknown_imageuri: This imageURI does not exist in this mesh: {orig}
tex.err_shared_atlas: {orig} cannot be replaced because it is shared by multiple buildings (owners: {owners})
tex.err_not_jpeg: The image is not a JPEG
tex.err_image_too_large: The image is too large (over 30 MB)
tex.err_virtual_name_mismatch: The virtual atlas name does not match the target building: {orig}
tex.err_ring_no_id: Cannot add textures because the exterior ring has no gml:id: {pid}
tex.err_appearance_not_unique: Cannot append automatically because app:Appearance is not unique
tex.err_cc0_required: Agreement to the data contribution policy (CC0) is required (docs/data-contribution-policy.md)
tex.err_udx_dirty:
There are changes to files other than the target under udx/. Please clean them up first:
{list}
tex.err_push_failed:
Could not send to GitHub. Your edits remain on this screen. Check your internet connection and try again.
{stderr}
tex.note_confirm_github: Complete the submission on the GitHub confirmation screen.
pr.tex_ids_note: Missing polygon IDs (gml:id) were added to the target building first (standard GML attributes; coordinates unchanged).
pr.tex_mechanism_new: **New textures** for a building without any (appearance block added with new images, #119). Coordinates are unchanged; the UVs are generated from wall clusters (consistent with R1/R3).
pr.tex_mechanism_update: Existing images are never overwritten: new images are added and the imageURI values are swapped (consistent with R1/R3). UVs and the XML structure are unchanged.
pr.rights_body: The submitter agrees that the photos used are their own, that they are provided as **CC0 1.0** (moral rights will not be exercised), and that they have confirmed the notes on portrait rights and personal information ([Data Contribution Policy]({url}) v2).
